articles.title: Ideas. Change. Everything.
articles.teaser: Our inaugural flagship event brought together 8 speakers. Explore the talks, the stories, and the ideas that started it all.
articles.body:
On the evening of 26 March 2025, TEDxNortheasternU London held its inaugural flagship event, Ideas. Change. Everything., at Devon House. Rooted in the belief that transformative ideas are born at the edge of discomfort, the evening brought together eight speakers — students and industry leaders alike — who challenged assumptions around identity, confidence, inclusion, beauty, and belonging.

Student speakers Jack Wagoner, Wilder Carrigan, Grace Culver, Sarah Lerma, Julia Clark, and James Mathai shared deeply personal talks shaped by their academic work and lived experience, while industry speakers Asif Sadiq of Warner Bros. Discovery and Sulayman Sayes of Bott and Co brought perspectives from the world of business and law. Each talk asked its own version of the same question: what if the ideas we doubt most are the ones most worth chasing?

The night marked the culmination of a six-week workshop series that helped student speakers find their voice, and the first time the spirit of TED reached the Northeastern University London community. It was an evening of storytelling, leadership, and entrepreneurship that set the tone for everything TEDxNortheasternU London hopes to build going forward.
